title: ProgressionCurves
description: Player + companion progression scaling coefficients. Loaded by ContentProvider into IContentProvider.ProgressionCurves; consumed by Workmanship/CraftingService (skillDivisor) and Companion (layer thresholds). File is OPTIONAL — if absent, ContentProvider falls back to the historical hardcoded constants.

skillDivisor.description: Divisor applied to craftingSkill when computing the workmanship skill bonus. Lower = more skill contribution. Historical default: 20.

companionLayerThresholds.description: Map of CompanionType name → 6-element threshold array. Index i = UsageCounter required to unlock layer i+1. Index 0 is conventionally 0 (already at layer 1). All 5 CompanionType enum values must be present.

companionRubberBand.description: Companion XP catch-up scaling. mult = clamp(1 + max(0, playerLevel - layer*playerLevelWeight) * perGapBonus, 1.0, maxMultiplier). Block is OPTIONAL — absent means defaults (3, 0.15, 3.0) are used.

playerLevelWeight.description: How many player levels 'equal' one companion layer for gap-measurement purposes. Historical default: 3.

perGapBonus.description: XP-multiplier increment per unit of player-level gap. Historical default: 0.15.

maxMultiplier.description: Upper clamp on the rubber-band multiplier. Historical default: 3.0.
